name: edupage-keyring-mcp
description: EduPage timetables, grades, homework and messages; session in the OS Credential Store, no password.
long_description:
Lets Claude read your EduPage school account: timetables, grades, homework, tests, absences, messages, menus and more, for every child and school you have.

You sign in once per school in Chrome, on EduPage's own page, two-factor included. Only EduPage's session cookie is kept, in your computer's Credential Store (the macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager); no password is ever stored or configured. Tick "Remember password" in EduPage's own dialog and the extension also keeps what EduPage issues for that, so it can sign in again by itself. Requires macOS or Windows (Windows support is beta) and Google Chrome.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by aSc Applied Software Consultants, the company that makes EduPage.

school.title: School
school.description: The name before .edupage.org (myschool), or your school's EduPage address. Several schools: separate them with commas; the first is the default.

keep_alive.title: Keep-alive (minutes)
keep_alive.description: EduPage signs you out after about two hours without use. While Claude is open, the extension loads your EduPage home page this often (5-120 minutes, default 60) so you stay signed in. 0 turns it off.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Check that the Saved Session in the Credential Store still works. If not, call sign_in; `signin` shows a sign-in in progress or its last result.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Open EduPage's own sign-in page in a Chrome window on this computer when the session is missing or expired. Call it only after the person agreed to sign in. The person types their password there; it never passes through this tool. Returns at once; then call wait_for_sign_in.

tools.name: wait_for_sign_in
tools.description: Wait up to `seconds` (max 50) for the Chrome sign-in started by sign_in to finish. Returns READY when the new session works, SIGNIN_IN_PROGRESS if the person is still signing in (call again), or the failure code.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Messages since a date (up to 90 days back, default 30): id, sender, snippet, number of files. Open one with get_message.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Full text and attached files of a message returned by list_messages. Reading sends no read receipt.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: One file attached to a message (PDF, PNG, JPEG or GIF, up to 3 MB), base64. `file` comes from get_message.

tools.name: list_schools
tools.description: List configured schools with session status and account role.

tools.name: list_children
tools.description: List the children this account can see, with name, class and ref. Use the name or ref as `child` in other tools.

tools.name: user_id
tools.description: Return the EduPage user ID and role (parent, student, teacher) for a school.

tools.name: school_year
tools.description: Return the current school year (starting year).

tools.name: find_student
tools.description: Find students in the school by (part of) their name.

tools.name: get_timetable
tools.description: A child's lessons for one date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today).

tools.name: get_week_timetable
tools.description: A child's Monday-Friday lessons for the week containing `week_of` (default this week, or next week on weekends).

tools.name: get_timetable_for
tools.description: Timetable of a teacher, student, class or classroom (target_type) by its ID on a date.

tools.name: get_periods
tools.description: The school's bell schedule (period start and end times).

tools.name: get_next_ringing_time
tools.description: Next bell (lesson or break) after an ISO datetime (default now).

tools.name: get_timetable_changes
tools.description: Substitutions and timetable changes for a date (default today).

tools.name: get_missing_teachers
tools.description: Teachers absent on a date (default today).

tools.name: get_grades
tools.description: A child's grades; optionally a past term with year (e.g. 2025) and term FIRST|SECOND.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: Timeline items since a date (max 90 days back, default 30). Optional `child` limits to that child; `types` is a comma list of EduPage types (e.g. homework,znamka).

tools.name: get_homework
tools.description: Homework with title, subject and due date. `since` is YYYY-MM-DD, max 90 days back (default 30); `child` limits to one child.

tools.name: get_assignments
tools.description: Homework, tests and exams. `since` is YYYY-MM-DD, max 90 days back (default 30); `child` limits to one child.

tools.name: get_absences
tools.description: Absences, excuses and arrival/departure scans. `since` is YYYY-MM-DD, max 90 days back (default 30); `child` limits to one child.

tools.name: get_upcoming_events
tools.description: School events, trips, meetings, holidays and tests announced as events. `since` is YYYY-MM-DD, max 90 days back (default 30); `child` limits to one child.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: School news posts. `since` is YYYY-MM-DD, max 90 days back (default 30); `child` limits to one child.

tools.name: get_meals
tools.description: A child's menus, allergens and current order for a date. Returns MEALS_NOT_AVAILABLE if the school has no canteen module.

tools.name: choose_meal
tools.description: ORDER a meal for a child. meal_type: snack|lunch|afternoon_snack; number: 1-based menu (1=A).

tools.name: sign_off_meal
tools.description: CANCEL a child's meal for a date. meal_type: snack|lunch|afternoon_snack.

tools.name: rate_meal
tools.description: RATE a served lunch 1-5 for quality and quantity (meal_type must be lunch).

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: SEND an EduPage message as this account. recipient: one ID like Teacher123 (from get_teachers).

tools.name: get_students
tools.description: Students in your class (or your children, for parents).

tools.name: get_all_students
tools.description: Short list of all students in the school.

tools.name: get_teachers
tools.description: All teachers, with IDs usable for send_message.

tools.name: get_classes
tools.description: All classes.

tools.name: get_classrooms
tools.description: All classrooms.

tools.name: get_subjects
tools.description: All subjects.
